{{Top|leg}}
The '''remodulating buffer heatsink''' was a component of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Without the heatsink, a vessel's hyperdrive would not engage. After suffering a blown hyperdrive due to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]'s sabotage, the remodulating buffer heatsink on the ''[[FarStar]]''{{'s}} jury-rigged [[Engine/Legends|engines]] blew after reaching [[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|''Tanquilla Beach'']].
